places.quote: Before he went abroad, and as he passed through London on his way,
places.note: Mr. Brownlow's account of his father's journey; the place is not a setting in this passage.

places.quote: It was necessary that he should immediately repair to Rome, whither this man had sped for health,
places.note: Recounted past event; Monks's uncle's death and his own death occur there.

places.quote: was followed, the moment the intelligence reached Paris, by your mother who carried you with her;
places.note: Recounted past event; the mother's location.
